plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images in data/train/images/, (2) structure of annotations.json (categories, images, annotations counts), (3) annotation distribution per image (min/max/mean), (4) category distribution (how many annotations per category), (5) image dimensions, (6) structure of metadata.json, (7) reference product images in data/products/. Log all findings.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of data properties: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, reference image availability per category

plan.title: Explore package versions and environment
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes, onnxruntime. Install ultralytics==8.1.0 if not present. Verify GPU availability and VRAM. Log all versions.
plan.success_criteria: ultralytics==8.1.0 confirmed installed, GPU confirmed available, all critical package versions logged

plan.title: Create 90/10 stratified train/val split
plan.description: Write a script to split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json (COCO format). Split by image, seed=42. Stratify by store section (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker) — infer section from image filename or folder structure. ~223 train, ~25 val images. Save both JSON files.
plan.success_criteria: Two valid COCO-format JSON files created with proportional section representation in val split

plan.title: Write evaluation function for val_score
plan.description: Implement in utils.py: (1) detection_mAP@0.5 — all predictions mapped to single category, evaluate with COCOeval, (2) classification_mAP@0.5 — evaluate with original category_ids, (3) val_score = 0.7 * det_mAP + 0.3 * cls_mAP. Function takes predictions list and val_split.json path, returns all three metrics. Test with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function returns correct metrics on dummy data, handles edge cases (no predictions, empty images)

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write a conversion script that creates YOLO-format label files from train_split.json and val_split.json. Create a dataset YAML config file for ultralytics training. Handle the 357 categories (0-356). Create proper directory structure.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO-format labels created, dataset.yaml valid, ready for ultralytics training

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at 640px achieves val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Run inference on val split, compute val_score using evaluation function. This establishes the minimum baseline.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, val_score computed and logged as baseline reference

plan.title: YOLOv8s nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n by at least 0.03 val_score due to more capacity
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline (nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100). Compare val_score to YOLOv8n.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over YOLOv8n baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves val_score with more model capacity for 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m, nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=150. Compare to previous results.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over YOLOv8s

plan.title: YOLOv8n nc=1 (detection-only) at 640
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection_mAP than nc=357 since it doesn't need to classify
plan.description: Convert annotations to single class (all category_id=0). Train YOLOv8n nc=1, imgsz=640, epochs=100. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 and compare to nc=357 models. This tests whether separating detection from classification is beneficial.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 is higher than nc=357 YOLOv8n detection_mAP

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution with nc=1 significantly improves detection on dense shelves with small products
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=150, batch=8 (reduced for memory). Compare detection_mAP to 640px models.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 improves by at least 0.05 over 640px version

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l at 1280 provides the best detection performance within reasonable training time
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, batch=4-8. This is a strong detection backbone candidate.
plan.success_criteria: Highest detection_mAP@0.5 so far

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x provides marginal detection improvement over YOLOv8l but is worth testing
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, batch=2-4. Compare to YOLOv8l. Check if the improvement justifies the larger model size and slower inference.
plan.success_criteria: Compare detection_mAP to YOLOv8l; log inference time per image

plan.title: Explore reference product images for classification
plan.description: Analyze data/products/ directory: count products with reference images, image types available (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.), image quality/size. Cross-reference with annotation categories to see coverage. Determine how many of the 357 categories have reference photos.
plan.success_criteria: Know exactly which categories have reference images, how many images per product, and image properties

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding pipeline
plan.description: Implement a DINOv2-base embedding extractor using timm (dinov2_vitb14). Write functions to: (1) extract embeddings from image crops, (2) build a gallery from reference product images + training annotation crops, (3) classify a crop via kNN against the gallery. Use cosine similarity.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline produces 768-dim embeddings, gallery built successfully, kNN classification returns category_id and confidence

plan.title: DINOv2-base kNN classification on ground-truth val crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base with kNN achieves classification accuracy > 40% on ground-truth val crops
plan.description: Extract ground-truth crops from val images using val_split.json bounding boxes. Classify each crop using DINOv2 gallery (built from training crops + reference images). Measure top-1 and top-5 accuracy. This gives an upper bound on classification quality independent of detection.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy measured and logged; understand DINOv2 capability on this dataset

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: best nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than any nc=357 model
plan.description: Run best nc=1 detector on val images, crop detections, classify with DINOv2 kNN. Compute full val_score. Compare to best nc=357 model.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best nc=357 model

plan.title: Tune kNN hyperparameters (k, temperature, distance metric)
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k and temperature improve classification mAP by 0.02+
plan.description: Sweep k in {1, 3, 5, 7, 11}, temperature in {0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2}, and compare cosine vs L2 distance. Use ground-truth val crops for fast iteration. Pick best combo.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN config identified, classification accuracy improvement logged

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: Optimal gallery weighting of reference vs training crops improves classification
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (1) reference images only, (2) training crops only, (3) reference 3x + training crops 1x, (4) reference 1x + training crops 2x. Evaluate on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified with measurable classification improvement

plan.title: NMS and confidence threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves detection mAP on dense shelves
plan.description: Using best detector, sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8} and confidence threshold {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35} on val split. Measure detection_mAP@0.5 for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal NMS/confidence thresholds found, detection_mAP improvement logged

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA improves detection mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run best detector with augment=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP and val_score to non-TTA. Also measure inference time increase.
plan.success_criteria: TTA impact quantified; decide if worth the inference time cost

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference at 1280 with overlap significantly improves detection of small products
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice each image into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Compare detection_mAP to single-pass inference.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by 0.03+ over single-pass inference

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training nc=1 at 1280
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l provides complementary detection errors to YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l (available in ultralytics 8.1.0) with nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=200. Compare standalone detection_mAP to best YOLO model. Note: RT-DETR uses transformer decoder, different from YOLO's anchor-based approach.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l detection_mAP logged; compare to YOLO and assess ensemble potential

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves detection mAP by 2-4 points over best single model
plan.description: Run both best YOLO and RT-DETR on val images. Merge predictions using Weighted Boxes Fusion (ensemble-boxes package). Tune WBF IoU threshold and model weights. Evaluate detection_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble detection_mAP exceeds best single model by 0.02+

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 1280 (full classification model)
plan.hypothesis: A large YOLO model trained with all 357 classes at high resolution provides competitive classification
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=300, close_mosaic=50. Compare its classification_mAP to the two-stage DINOv2 approach. Also compare detection_mAP to nc=1 version.
plan.success_criteria: val_score computed; compare YOLO-only classification vs DINOv2 classification

plan.title: Confidence-gated hybrid classification
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves overall classification
plan.description: For each detection from nc=357 YOLO: if YOLO class confidence > threshold, use YOLO's category_id; otherwise, use DINOv2 kNN classification. Sweep confidence threshold on val split. Compare to pure DINOv2 and pure YOLO classification.
plan.success_criteria: Hybrid approach achieves higher classification_mAP than either method alone

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large (dinov2_vitl14) from timm, build gallery, evaluate on val crops. Compare classification accuracy to DINOv2-base. Measure embedding extraction time and model size.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison logged; size/speed tradeoff quantified

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A learned projection head with ArcFace/SupCon loss improves embedding quality for product classification
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, add 2-layer MLP projection head (768→512→256). Train with ArcFace loss on training crops + reference images. Evaluate on val crops. Compare to raw DINOv2 embeddings.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improves over raw DINOv2 embeddings by 3%+

plan.title: Training with longer epochs and close_mosaic tuning
plan.hypothesis: Longer training with extended close_mosaic period improves detection on this small dataset
plan.description: Using best model config, train for 500 epochs with close_mosaic=100 (vs previous 50). Compare val_score. Also try close_mosaic=150.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from longer/better training schedule

plan.title: Progressive resizing: 640→1280
plan.hypothesis: Starting at 640 then switching to 1280 gives faster convergence and potentially better generalization
plan.description: Train best model at 640 for 100 epochs, then resume at 1280 for 200 epochs. Compare to training at 1280 from scratch for 300 epochs (same total compute).
plan.success_criteria: Compare val_score and training time to direct 1280 training

plan.title: Label smoothing and focal loss for nc=357
plan.hypothesis: Label smoothing helps with noisy labels and visually similar categories
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=357 with label_smoothing=0.1. Compare to no label smoothing. Also test fl_gamma=1.5 (focal loss) for class imbalance.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations improves classification robustness
plan.description: For each detection crop, extract 4 variations: (1) original, (2) center 80% zoom, (3) 10% padded, (4) slight brightness augment. Average embeddings before kNN lookup. Compare to single-crop classification.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improves by 1%+ over single-crop

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Patch-level token matching is more robust to occlusion than global embedding
plan.description: Instead of CLS token, use all patch tokens from DINOv2. Compute similarity as average of best-matching patches between query and gallery. Compare to CLS-only matching on val crops.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison logged; understand if patch-level helps for occluded products

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Synthetic augmentation using reference product photos improves rare category detection
plan.description: Implement copy-paste: extract product images from data/products/, apply perspective warp and lighting adjustment, paste onto shelf backgrounds. Generate augmented training images for rare categories. Retrain best model.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves, especially classification_mAP for rare categories

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification post-processing
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf section are correlated; co-occurrence priors improve classification
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data (which categories appear in the same image). For each val image, after initial classification, re-weight category probabilities using co-occurrence with other high-confidence detections in the same image.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves by 0.01+ with co-occurrence post-processing

plan.title: Spatial consistency post-processing
plan.hypothesis: Adjacent identical products on shelves can be used to improve classification consistency
plan.description: For each image, group detections by spatial proximity (same shelf row, adjacent positions). If multiple adjacent detections have similar DINOv2 embeddings, assign them all the same category (majority vote or highest confidence). This exploits the shelf stacking pattern.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves from spatial consistency enforcement

plan.title: Train at 1920 resolution
plan.hypothesis: Training at 1920 (close to native resolution) captures more product detail
plan.description: Train best nc=1 model at imgsz=1920, batch=1-2 with gradient accumulation. Compare detection_mAP to 1280. Check if the improvement justifies the training cost.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison logged; assess feasibility for inference within 300s

plan.title: Rectangular inference (rect=True)
plan.hypothesis: Rectangular inference preserves aspect ratio better and improves detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run best detector with rect=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: CLAHE preprocessing for detection
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detect products in poorly lit shelf areas
plan.description: Apply CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) to val images before detection. Compare detection_mAP to unprocessed images. If beneficial, integrate into inference pipeline.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP comparison logged

plan.title: Score threshold optimization for mAP
plan.hypothesis: Very low confidence threshold (0.001-0.01) maximizes mAP by providing more recall
plan.description: Sweep confidence threshold from 0.001 to 0.5 on val split. Since mAP considers precision-recall curve, more predictions at low confidence can help. Find optimal threshold.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal confidence threshold found that maximizes val_score

plan.title: Multi-scale ensemble: same model at different resolutions
plan.hypothesis: Running the same model at 640 + 1280 + 1920 and merging catches products at different scales
plan.description: Run best detector at 3 resolutions, merge with WBF. Compare to single-resolution inference. Measure inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves over single resolution; inference time within budget

plan.title: Per-category adaptive classification thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Different categories need different confidence thresholds for optimal classification
plan.description: For each category, find the DINOv2 similarity threshold that maximizes F1 on val split. Categories with unique packaging get low thresholds (easy to identify), similar-looking products get high thresholds (only classify when very confident, else fall back to category_id=0).
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves with per-category thresholds vs global threshold

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling on test images for gallery augmentation
plan.hypothesis: High-confidence test detections can augment the DINOv2 gallery for better classification
plan.description: Implement two-pass inference: (1) run detector + classifier on all test images, (2) add crops with score > 0.9 to gallery, (3) re-classify all detections with augmented gallery. Simulate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves with pseudo-label augmented gallery

plan.title: ONNX export and inference speed benchmark
plan.hypothesis: ONNX inference is faster than PyTorch, enabling more tiles or TTA within 300s budget
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX FP16 (opset ≤ 20). Export DINOv2 to ONNX FP16. Benchmark inference speed on val split. Compare to PyTorch inference. Calculate total time budget for test set.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX models exported successfully, inference time per image logged, total time within 300s

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO model
plan.hypothesis: INT8 YOLO loses <0.5 detection_mAP but saves significant model size and inference time
plan.description: Quantize best YOLO model to INT8 via ONNX post-training quantization. Compare detection_mAP, model size, and inference speed to FP16.
plan.success_criteria: INT8 model size and speed logged; detection_mAP drop < 0.5 points

plan.title: Two YOLO models ensemble within size budget
plan.hypothesis: Two diverse detectors ensembled outperform one large detector
plan.description: If INT8 YOLO is viable: combine YOLOv8x INT8 + RT-DETR-l FP16 + DINOv2-base FP16. Check total size < 420MB. Evaluate ensemble val_score vs single model.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble fits in 420MB and achieves higher val_score than single model

plan.title: Tiled inference + TTA combined
plan.hypothesis: Combining tiling and TTA provides maximum detection recall
plan.description: Run tiled inference with TTA on each tile. Merge all predictions with WBF. Compare to tiling-only and TTA-only. Measure total inference time carefully.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement quantified; check if inference time fits in 300s

plan.title: Crop from original resolution for DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Extracting DINOv2 crops from full-resolution images gives better embeddings than from YOLO's resized input
plan.description: Map detection boxes back to original image coordinates, crop from full-res source. Compare DINOv2 classification accuracy to crops from resized images.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison logged

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling for nc=357 training
plan.hypothesis: Oversampling rare categories improves classification for long-tail distribution
plan.description: Implement image-level oversampling: duplicate images containing rare categories (< 5 annotations) in training. Retrain nc=357 model. Compare classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: classification_mAP improves, especially for rare categories

plan.title: Weighted loss for corrected annotations
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting manually corrected annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Check if annotations have a 'corrected' field. If so, duplicate corrected annotations or implement loss weighting. Retrain and compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison with and without annotation weighting

plan.title: DINOv2 with register tokens (dinov2_vitb14_reg)
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 with register tokens produces cleaner embeddings
plan.description: If available in timm 0.9.12, load dinov2_vitb14_reg. Compare embedding quality on val crops to standard dinov2_vitb14.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison logged

plan.title: Embedding similarity histogram analysis
plan.description: Plot distribution of DINOv2 cosine similarities for correct matches vs incorrect matches on val crops. Identify the separability gap. This informs optimal thresholds and whether the embedding space is discriminative enough.
plan.success_criteria: Histogram plotted, separability gap quantified, optimal threshold range identified

plan.title: Category grouping: coarse-to-fine classification
plan.hypothesis: First classifying into store sections then fine-grained categories improves accuracy
plan.description: Group 357 categories into 4 store sections. First classify crop into section (4-way), then classify within section (fewer candidates). Compare to flat 357-way classification.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improves with hierarchical approach

plan.title: Ensemble of DINOv2 + CLIP embeddings
plan.hypothesis: CLIP provides complementary text-aware features that help distinguish similar products
plan.description: If CLIP is available (via timm or torch hub), extract CLIP visual embeddings for crops. Concatenate or average with DINOv2 embeddings. Compare classification accuracy.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison logged

plan.title: Build complete inference pipeline
plan.description: Assemble the best configuration into a complete run.py: (1) load YOLO model, (2) load DINOv2 model, (3) load gallery, (4) for each image: detect → crop → classify → format output. Handle all edge cases. Test on val split end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json, val_score matches component-level evaluation

plan.title: End-to-end inference timing on val split
plan.hypothesis: Complete pipeline runs within 300s for ~25 test images (extrapolating to full test set)
plan.description: Time the complete pipeline on val split. Extrapolate to expected test set size. Identify bottlenecks. Optimize if needed (batch DINOv2 inference, ONNX, etc.).
plan.success_criteria: Estimated total inference time < 300s for expected test set size

plan.title: Model size audit and optimization
plan.hypothesis: All model weights fit within 420MB total
plan.description: Check sizes of all weight files (YOLO .pt/.onnx, DINOv2 .pt/.onnx, gallery .npy, any other files). If over 420MB, apply FP16 conversion or INT8 quantization to largest files.
plan.success_criteria: Total weight files < 420MB, max 3 weight files

plan.title: Ensure sandbox compatibility
plan.description: Review run.py for blocked imports (no os, sys, subprocess, etc.). Use pathlib instead of os. Verify no pickle, yaml, eval, exec usage. Test that all imports are from pre-installed packages. Rename any .bin files to .pt.
plan.success_criteria: run.py passes all sandbox security restrictions

plan.title: Final val_score evaluation with best configuration
plan.hypothesis: Best configuration achieves val_score > 0.50
plan.description: Run complete pipeline on val split with all optimizations (best detector, best classifier, best post-processing). Log final val_score breakdown: detection_mAP, classification_mAP, combined score.
plan.success_criteria: Final val_score logged with full breakdown

plan.title: Document best configuration for human retraining
plan.description: Write a clear summary of the best configuration: model architecture, training hyperparameters, image size, augmentation settings, DINOv2 variant, gallery composition, kNN parameters, post-processing settings. Include exact commands to reproduce.
plan.success_criteria: Complete reproducible configuration documented

plan.title: Package final submission zip
plan.description: Create submission.zip containing: run.py, model weights (≤3 files, ≤420MB), gallery file, any helper .py files. Verify zip structure matches requirements. Test extraction and run.
plan.success_criteria: Valid submission.zip created, run.py executes correctly from extracted zip
